content: 1. Famotidine 40 mg is prescribed to be taken twice daily (BID). 2. Nizatidine increases the levels or effects of tazemetostat by influencing the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Caution and monitoring are advised. 3. Nizatidine increases the levels or effects of tinidazole by affecting the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Caution and monitoring are advised. 4. Nizatidine increases the levels or effects of varenicline by reducing renal clearance. Caution and monitoring are advised. 5. Nizatidine decreases the levels or effects of vismodegib due to changes in gastric pH, which alters its solubility and reduces bioavailability. The impact on efficacy is unknown. Caution and monitoring are advised. 6. Blessed thistle reduces the effects of nizatidine through pharmacodynamic antagonism. This interaction is considered minor, and its clinical significance is unknown. 7. Nizatidine increases the levels or effects of ceftibuten through an unspecified interaction mechanism. This interaction is minor, and its clinical significance is unknown. 8. Nizatidine decreases cyanocobalamin (vitamin B12) levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. The interaction is minor, and its clinical significance is unknown. 9. Devil's claw reduces the effects of nizatidine through pharmacodynamic antagonism. This interaction is minor, and its clinical significance is unknown. 10. Nizatidine increases the levels or effects of glipizide by raising gastric pH. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. The interaction is minor, and its clinical significance is unknown. 11. Nizatidine increases the levels or effects of glyburide by raising gastric pH. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. The interaction is minor, and its clinical significance is unknown. 12. Nizatidine decreases the levels of phytoestrogens by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. The interaction is minor, and its clinical significance is unknown. 13. Nizatidine increases the levels or effects of ruxolitinib topical by affecting the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. This interaction is minor, and its clinical significance is unknown. Close monitoring is recommended. 14. Nizatidine decreases the levels or effects of acalabrutinib by raising gastric pH, which reduces its solubility and bioavailability. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Acalabrutinib should be administered 2 hours before an H2-receptor antagonist. 15. Nizatidine increases the levels or effects of alendronate through an unknown mechanism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 16. Nizatidine increases the levels or effects of aripiprazole by affecting the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. 17. Nizatidine decreases the levels or effects of atazanavir by raising gastric pH, which reduces its solubility and bioavailability. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid or use an alternative drug. For treatment-naïve patients, atazanavir should be taken simultaneously with the H2-receptor antagonist or at least 10 hours afterward. 18. Nizatidine increases the levels or effects of atogepant by affecting the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Caution and monitoring are advised. 19. Nizatidine increases the levels or effects of avapritinib by affecting the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Caution and monitoring are advised. 20. Nizatidine increases the levels of axitinib by affecting the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Caution and monitoring are advised. 21. Nizatidine decreases the effects of budesonide by raising gastric pH, which may cause premature dissolution of extended-release budesonide tablets. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. 22. Nizatidine decreases the levels or effects of carbonyl iron by raising gastric pH. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Caution and monitoring are advised. 23. Nizatidine decreases the levels or effects of cefdinir by raising gastric pH. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Caution and monitoring are advised. 27. Nizatidine decreases the levels of crizotinib by raising gastric pH, which reduces its solubility and bioavailability. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Caution and monitoring are advised. 28. Nizatidine increases the levels or effects of cyclosporine through an unknown mechanism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 29. Nizatidine decreases the levels or effects of dabrafenib by raising gastric pH, which reduces its solubility and bioavailability. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Caution and monitoring are advised. 30. Nizatidine decreases the levels or effects of dasatinib by raising gastric pH. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 31. Nizatidine increases the levels or effects of dexmethylphenidate by raising gastric pH. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. 32. Nizatidine increases the levels or effects of digoxin by raising gastric pH. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 33. Nizatidine decreases the levels or effects of ferric maltol by raising gastric pH. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Caution and monitoring are advised. 36. Nizatidine decreases the levels or effects of ferrous fumarate, ferrous gluconate, and ferrous sulfate by raising gastric pH. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Caution and monitoring are advised. 37. Nizatidine increases the levels or effects of finerenone by affecting the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. 38. Nizatidine increases the levels or effects of flibanserin by affecting the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Caution and monitoring are advised. 39. Nizatidine decreases the levels or effects of fosamprenavir by raising gastric pH. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Caution and monitoring are advised. 40. Nizatidine decreases the levels of gefitinib by raising gastric pH. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Caution and monitoring are advised. Separate gefitinib and H2-antagonist doses by at least 6 hours. 41. Nizatidine decreases the levels or effects of indinavir by raising gastric pH. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 42. Nizatidine decreases the levels or effects of itraconazole by raising gastric pH. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Caution and monitoring are advised. 44. Nizatidine decreases the levels or effects of ketoconazole by raising gastric pH. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 45. Nizatidine decreases the levels or effects of ledipasvir/sofosbuvir due to changes in gastric pH. H2-receptor antagonists may be administered simultaneously with or 12 hours apart from ledipasvir/sofosbuvir at doses comparable to famotidine 40 mg BID. 46. Nizatidine increases the levels or effects of lemborexant by affecting the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. 47. Nizatidine decreases the levels or effects of levoketoconazole by raising gastric pH. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 48. Lomitapide dosage should not exceed 30 mg/day. 49. Nizatidine increases the levels or effects of lonafarnib by affecting the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Avoid this interaction by administering H2 antagonists 10 hours after or 2 hours before nilotinib. 58. Nizatidine decreases the levels or effects of pazopanib by raising gastric pH. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid or use an alternative drug.
